text:
in earth lejana

I have I a hermana.


always in spring

my llegada espera

tras of the window.


and a the golondrina

that in his rejas trina

dice with dulzura:


-¡Por aquella espina

that arrancaste a Cristo,

dime if le has visto

cruzar the llanura!


¡the ave his queja

lanza temerosa,

and in the afternoon rose,

bajo the sun itself aleja!


from his window,

my pálida hermana

pregunta al traveler

that camina sad:


-¡Por your love primero,

dime if le viste

por ese sendero!


¡Pero the pasajero

his calvario sube,

and itself aleja lento,

dejando a nube

of polvo in the wind!


from his window

a the moon grita

my pálida hermana:


-¡Por the faz bendita

of the Crucificado,

dime in what sendero

your rayo postrero

his paso ha alumbrado!


¡the moon the vaga

llanura ilumina,

trémula declina,

and in the sea itself apaga!


Acaso I, errante,

pasé vacilante

baja your window,

and without conocerme,

my pálida hermana,

preguntes al verme

venir tan lejano:


-Dime, peregrino:

¿has visto a my hermano

por ese path?
